about_short_description.short_description: Teleo provides construction equipment by converting existing fleet into remote-controlled robots.

product.name: Teleo Supervised Autonomy
product.description: A system that retrofits heavy construction equipment to enable remote control and semi-autonomous operation, allowing one operator to manage multiple machines from a remote command center.

product.name: Teleo Universal Retrofit Kit
product.description: A hardware kit that can be installed on any make, model, or year of heavy equipment to enable remote and autonomous operation capabilities.

product.name: Teleo Remote Command Center
product.description: A centralized control facility where operators remotely manage multiple Teleo-equipped heavy machines using joysticks and monitors.

product.name: Teleo Proprietary Software
product.description: Software that enables remote control, autonomous functions, and operational analytics for Teleo-equipped heavy machinery.

product.name: Teleo Robust Mesh Network
product.description: A communication network that connects Teleo-equipped machines and the remote command center to enable reliable data and control signal transmission.
